entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet, God of Solidarity.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet, God of Knowledge.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet, God of Ambition.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet, God of Zeal, who was left to guide the survivors of Naktamun.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet, God of Strength.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: A god warped by Bolas who would destroy the Hekma.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: A god warped by Bolas who would lead the Eternals.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: A god warped by Bolas who would kill the other gods, killed during the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Not technically a god, but worshiped as the God-Pharaoh of Amonkhet and as god-emperor of Madara.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane whose gods take an active hand in their worshippers' lives in the city of Naktamun.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: The hydra-god of Alara.

entities.name: Beza
entities.description: A Calamity Beast widely venerated by the animalfolk of Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Svyelun of Sea and Sky
entities.description: The Merfolk god of Dominaria, the only Dominarian deity on a card with the god creature type.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A goddess to elves worshiped in Fyndhorn, Skyshroud and Llanowar.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: A goddess worshiped across Dominaria, most prominently by druids.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: An ancient mountain god originally worshipped by the Brotherhood of Gix.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker worshiped in Sursi and around Dominaria.

entities.name: Tal
entities.description: An ancient Sun God worshiped during the Dark Age, from whose tear the Golgothian Sylex was said to be made.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A figure worshiped by many of Dominaria's catfolk.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A false god worshiped in Otaria, conflated with Offkirch after her rebirth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Phyrexian who attained godhood by fusing with the planar core of Phyrexia.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The elder demon and ruler of Duskmourn, worshipped by the Cult of Valgavoth for devouring fear.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon worshiped among the Skirsdag cultists of Innistrad.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon worshiped on Innistrad after Griselbrand's imprisonment.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel worshiped on Innistrad after the betrayal and destruction of Avacyn.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The sun at the center of Ixalan's Core, mother of the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The bat-god of night who opposed Chimil, led demons, and usurped the Ancient One's place.

entities.name: The Ancient One
entities.description: One of the Deep Gods of Ixalan's core, killed by Aclazotz and resurfaced as a spirit god.

entities.name: Ojer Taq
entities.description: The god of civilization, at the top of the Deep Gods' hierarchy.

entities.name: Ojer Pakpatiq
entities.description: The god of circular time, second in the Deep Gods' hierarchy.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The current ruling family of gods on Kaldheim, who supplanted the Einir.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The ancient ruling gods of Kaldheim, whose seven surviving leaders are imprisoned in Jaspera Trees.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: The Skoti god who created the Cosmos Elixir.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A cosmos monster through whom the Einir channeled the World Tree's essence.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The God of the Sun of Theros, who was compleated.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A minor god of Theros who was not compleated.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A major god of Theros whose champion is Callaphe.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A major god of Theros whose champion is Tymaret.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A major god of Theros whose champion is Anax.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: A major god of Theros whose champion is Renata.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A minor god of Theros, killed by Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: The planeswalker who killed Xenagos.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A demigod and champion of Heliod.

entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: A demigod and champion of Thassa.

entities.name: Omnath
entities.description: The origin of the primal mana pulsing throughout Zendikar.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane where belief and dreams eventually become true, so its gods were believed into existence.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane ruled by the Skoti gods and connected by the World Tree.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of the Oltec and the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Dungeons & Dragons gods
entities.description: Deities from Dungeons & Dragons such as Asmodeus, Bahamut, Tiamat and Vecna that received Magic cards.

events.summary: Most of the gods of Amonkhet die when Bolas returns and ushers in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret.
events.quote: Most of the gods died when Bolas returned and ushered in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret to guide the survivors of Naktamun.

events.summary: Bolas imprisons and warps three gods to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.
events.quote: Three other gods were imprisoned and warped by Bolas to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.

events.summary: The Scorpion God is killed during the Hour of Devastation.
events.quote: Killed during the Hour of Devastation.

events.summary: Aclazotz kills the Ancient One and usurps his place among the Deep Gods.
events.quote: He was killed by Aclazotz, who usurped his place in the pantheon.

events.summary: The Skoti supplant the Einir as Kaldheim's ruling gods.
events.quote: supplanted the ancient Einir a few centuries ago

events.summary: The Skoti defeat the Einir, losing the relics that sealed the demons in Immersturm.
events.quote: When the Skoti challenged the Einir's supremacy and defeated them, these relics were lost.

events.summary: The Phyrexians exploit belief on Theros, compleating followers and Heliod.
events.quote: it is known that Heliod was compleated and Ephara was not
God of Revels. Killed by Elspeth Tirel .

relations.note: Usurped his place in the pantheon.
relations.quote: He was killed by Aclazotz, who usurped his place in the pantheon.

Worshiped by the Oltec and Komon as the Threefold Sun and mother of the Deep Gods

relations.note: In direct opposition to the Inner Sun.
relations.quote: who is in direct opposition to Aclazotz , the bat god of night

relations.note: Worshiped as God-Pharaoh and pretended to be creator of the gods and the plane.
relations.quote: Nicol Bolas was worshiped as the God-Pharaoh of Amonkhet and pretended to be the creator of the gods and the plane.
